CREATE TABLE `type_zoo` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `exact_money` decimal(38,10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `tiny_negative` decimal(38,10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `a_datetime` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `a_timestamp` timestamp(6) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `a_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `a_time` time(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `a_json` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `raw_bytes` blob,
  `a_enum` enum('sad','ok','happy') DEFAULT NULL,
  `a_char_uuid` char(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `a_binary_uuid` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `no_value` text,
  `empty_text` text,
  `the_word_null` text,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;
